name: Wesley Fellowship Kick-off Event
description: Join our Wesley Fellowship on the Front Patio of Daniel Chapel for a night of worship. At Wesley we hope to be a place where all can Be, Belong, Connect, and Engage. We will begin with music, share our hopes for the new year together, and hear a message from our campus minister. This is an invitation to all our Furman family, but not an obligation!

name: Wesley Fellowship Gathering
description: Join us for a night of worship and fellowship. The Gathering is in the Garden Room of the Chapel at 7:45pm. We will connect with old friends and make new ones, share Joys & Concerns, and then Edward [our campus minister] will offer a short devotional. Of course, all safety protocols will be followed ... so bring your mask!

name: Wesley Fellowship Mtg
description: This spring we will be engaging in a study built around Donald Miller’s book/movie Blue Like Jazz – Exploring Blue Like Jazz. “Exploring Blue Like Jazz, is a study about how to do life and faith well in the phase after high school that some have termed ‘emerging adulthood.’ It’s a book intended to make growing up a little easier.” Each week we will look at different topics relevant to our lives like – Consumerism, Culture, Doubt, Money, Partying, etc. Join us every Tuesday @ 7:45pm in the Garden Room of the Chapel. All are invited to this time of fellowship, worship, and friends! We will be done [officially] around 9:15pm, but feel free to hang around!

name: Wesley Fellowship Mtn Getaway
description: Wesley Fellowship is going to Camp Asbury Hills to kick-off our new year. We will be leaving about noon on Saturday, Sept 1 and returning around noon on Sunday, Sept 2. This will be an opportunity to fellowship together, explore God's call on our new year, and challenge our spirits [and nerves] as we experience the Canopy Tour! What is the Canopy Tour? It is a high zip-wire tour through the tops of trees. The cost of the weekend is $20.

name: Wesley Fellowship Spring [Beach] Retreat
description: WESLEY SPRING [Beach] RETREAT Friday, April 13 at 4:00pm - April 15 at 3:00pm We will be staying at Sam's beachhouse in Beaufort. This is a great time to get away from the busy-ness that is Furman to relax, rejuvenate, and refocus on our lives as Christians. During the weekend we will be looking at Jesus' last days with his disciples - AFTER the Resurrection. The cost is $20. Please respond by March 31 with your money. If you have questions, please contact Edward.
